user.title: Pair an Arctic Controller
user.description: Open Home Assistant pairing on the physical controller, then enter its displayed certificate fingerprint and one-time code.

confirm.title: Pair discovered controller
confirm.description: Controller {device_id} was discovered at {host}. Confirm the fingerprint shown on that physical controller and enter its one-time code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Arctic Controller
reauth_confirm.description: Open a new pairing window on the physical controller. A changed certificate fingerprint must be explicitly entered and confirmed.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller
error.invalid_fingerprint: The TLS certificate does not match this fingerprint
error.invalid_response: The controller returned an invalid response
error.wrong_device: The pairing response came from a different controller

abort.not_arctic_controller: The discovered service is not an Arctic Controller
abort.reauth_failed: The config entry no longer exists
